gateDefinitions.version-admission: Explicitly review the exact public manifest SHA, both producer identities and source/framework origins before adding any release to the production contract.
gateDefinitions.version-aware-harness: Remove .NET10-only framework/root/expected-version assumptions from DEB/RPM/OCI/AUR install proofs, retain independent official dotnet coexistence, and bind family-specific RID/ABI expectations.
gateDefinitions.native-channel-lifecycle: Install through the real package manager or immutable OCI digest on the native target; verify aliases/branding, unmodified payload, dependency versions, offline console/apphost/HTTP/crypto/ICU as non-root, coexistence, upgrade/rollback/removal.
gateDefinitions.signed-publication: Bind reports to exact source/package/OCI bytes; verify complete matrix, approved signatures, immutable publication, anonymous post-install and actual hosted HTTPS metadata before advertising availability.
gateDefinitions.new-distro-runtime: The qualified archive has no Fedora45/Rocky9.8/Arch runtime evidence. Audit pinned OpenSSL/ICU loaders and actual target dependency providers, then run native probes before package qualification.
gateDefinitions.external-openssl11: Select a separately recorded, signed, licensed and maintained OpenSSL1.1 provider per distro/architecture, prove source/hash/ABI/configuration and consumer search paths, and repeat TLS/RSA/HTTP. No approved provider is admitted here; do not bundle libraries into the SDK.
gateDefinitions.external-core3-icu: Resolve the pinned Core3 loader ceiling75 against Debian ICU76 and Fedora/Arch ICU78. Review a separately recorded compatible ICU provider (historical evidence used66), keep globalization enabled and prove native use without changing SDK bytes.
gateDefinitions.aur-publication-10: Existing issue10 separately tracks AUR publication identity/SSH authorization and trusted PKGBUILD publication. Only x64 is currently selected; no AUR ARM admission is inferred.

dependencyReferenceScope: These package names are existing NET10 reference providers, not verified dependencies for any additional SDK. Record actual per-SDK native providers and versions.

externalReferences.observation: Fedora45 provides separately named OpenSSL3 compatibility libraries; default OpenSSL4 must not be assumed compatible.
Fedora45 ICU78.3 reference provider; individual SDK compatibility remains untested.
Archrolling observed ICU78.3; rolling versions require fresh verification.
Upstream NET8/9 end2026-11-10; NET7/6/5/Core3 are already out of upstream support. Community qualification does not extend this lifecycle.
OpenSSL1.1.1 public support ended2023-09-11; third-party maintenance must be established separately.
